description: Source code for encoding protocol buffer data into wire format, including varint, fixed64, fixed32, zigzag, and message encoding functions, as well as error definitions and reflection utilities.

methods.name: EncodeVarint
methods.description: Returns the varint encoding of a uint64 value.

methods.name: EncodeVarint (method)
methods.description: Encodes a uint64 as a varint into the Buffer.

methods.name: SizeVarint
methods.description: Calculates the size of a varint-encoded integer.

methods.name: EncodeFixed64
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit integer into the Buffer in little-endian format.

methods.name: EncodeFixed32
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit integer into the Buffer in little-endian format.

methods.name: EncodeZigzag64
methods.description: Zigzag-encodes a 64-bit integer and writes it to the Buffer.

methods.name: EncodeZigzag32
methods.description: Zigzag-encodes a 32-bit integer and writes it to the Buffer.

methods.name: EncodeRawBytes
methods.description: Encodes a byte slice with length prefix into the Buffer.

methods.name: EncodeStringBytes
methods.description: Encodes a string with length prefix into the Buffer.

methods.name: EncodeMessage
methods.description: Encodes a Message into the Buffer with length prefix.

methods.name: isNil
methods.description: Checks if a reflect.Value is nil, considering interface, map, pointer, and slice kinds.
